show-notes.show_notes: Episode 42 features an in-depth conversation with Sarah Chen, CTO of Nimbusec, discussing cybersecurity in cloud-native environments. The discussion covers Kubernetes security best practices, secret management, and the evolution of DevSecOps. Sarah demonstrates a live code example of implementing security scanning in CI/CD pipelines using open-source tools like Trivy and Clair. Key topics include container image hardening, network policies, and incident response strategies for microservices architectures. The episode concludes with insights on building security into development culture rather than treating it as an afterthought.
